rationale: The obligation asks whether (1) cover-page language establishes that applicable effluent limitations, monitoring, and compliance conditions must be drawn exclusively from the cover page and Parts I–IV, and (2) the cover page independently imposes enforceable conditions that bound which Part I–IV limits apply. The packet shows affirmative incorporation language ('in accordance with this cover page and the effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV hereof') and cover-page authorization terms (Outfall 001 designation, discharge coordinates, permit effective and expiration dates). That language directs compliance with the named sources but does not contain exclusivity terms ('only', 'solely', 'exclusively') and the packet does not show whether other permit sections, attachments, or appendices exist or carry conditions. The cover page does state independently enforceable authorization terms, but the packet omits Parts I–IV text, so the interaction between those cover-page terms and which Part I–IV limits and monitoring requirements apply cannot be established. Neither the burden for ACCEPT (establishing exclusive sourcing and bounding) nor for REJECT (establishing the proposition is false) is met; unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
